title: Diagnostics ring buffer design
description: Why a bounded ring buffer instead of a log file.
body: Every failure path in this crate writes to stderr and moves on, but a release build has no console attached. This is the ring buffer that keeps those lines in memory instead, readable afterwards by the settings UI or an agent over MCP. Process-wide static rather than Tauri state, and bounded rather than growing. Sized for 'what just happened', not for an audit trail: at roughly 120 bytes per record, 500 records is under 64 KB.
